items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Bill, did you meet him out in California? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah...

ctx.x: I never heard of him. Bill, did you meet him out in California?
Yeah, he's a little bit of short fella, just about that big. Did he play trumpet or anything else? No, he played straight, upright bass and bass violin. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
